newsitem.title: USA: Home Access Express HIV-1 test reaches market.
newsitem.headline: Home Access Express HIV-1 test reaches market.

text.p: Privatley held Home Access Corp. said Monday its over-the-counter Home Access Express HIV-1 Test System is being sold through Walgreen Co.'s 2,200 drugstores.
The product allows people to anonymously collect a blood sample, access professional pre-test and post-test counselling and receive test results in three business days.
Home Access received clearance in July to market its anonymous HIV-1 test system, the first anonymous testing and counselling system to be available nationwide.
